evidence_note: PrEP use is persistent but externally influenced; weak diagonal prior prevents unconstrained self-amplification while retaining PrEP-only drift.
Healthcare engagement should be persistent absent evidence of decline; weak diagonal prior prevents unexplained reversion while retaining no-drift specification.
General social stigma is upstream and persistent; weak diagonal prior discourages indefinite self-amplification in long-horizon projections.
Family stigma is upstream and persistent; weak diagonal prior discourages indefinite self-amplification in long-horizon projections.

Anticipated healthcare stigma responds to recent healthcare experiences (6-12 month items) but the state's healthcare environment carries over; half-life about 2 years per 2-year step. Replaces the implicit persistence from the covariance term (2026-11-18).
Past-year testing is a behaviour that can change quickly; half-life about 2 years (2026-11-18).
Past-year risk behaviour can change quickly; half-life about 2 years (2026-11-18).
Outness is slow-moving, like general and family stigma; half-life about 8.5 years (2026-11-18).
